verdicts.quote: Default schedule offsets, in calendar days relative to the invoice due date: -3, +1, +7, +14 (negative = before due). Weekends are not skipped.

Groups with distinct behaviour: open full balance (eligible); partially paid (eligible, remaining balance used); paid / balance = 0 (not); balance < 0 (not); void (not); draft (not) ... Excluded by scope: disputed/on-hold invoices
verdicts.missing: Whether disputed invoices, invoices on a payment plan, or invoices reduced by a credit note stop the sequence; disputed is only named as out of scope, payment plans are not mentioned

verdicts.quote: remaining balance as `<CURRENCY> <amount>` in the currency's minor units
Out of scope (bounded by this R): ... unsubscribe/reply handling (G-10)
verdicts.missing: Whether existing do-not-contact/paused/unsubscribed customer states suppress reminders, and whether billing notices are exempt from a marketing opt-out (deferred to G-10)

verdicts.quote: for each (invoice, offset) at most one message is ever handed to the provider ... Repeated runs, overlapping runs, restarts and schedule edits cannot create a second message.
the invoice is re-read from the invoice source immediately before the claim; if it is no longer eligible (paid, void, balance ≤ 0), no message is sent
a definite failure ... leaves the step due; each later daily run retries it once, up to 3 attempts total; the third failure → failed-final
verdicts.missing: Who is alerted when sends keep failing or a run fails (R-14/G-13 leave alerting unresolved)

verdicts.quote: Unresolved: acceptable maximum run duration / time of last send after 09:00, expected invoice volume per run, provider rate limits.
verdicts.missing: The rate limit value and how a large batch is paced within it

verdicts.quote: No backfill. A schedule entry only produces reminders for step dates on or after the date the entry became effective ... Enabling the feature must not email every overdue customer at once.
The run executes once per day at 09:00 in the account time zone (IANA name, default UTC).
Currency formatting follows the invoice currency's minor unit: a JPY invoice with balance 500 shows "JPY 500" (not "JPY 500.00").
Missing/invalid recipient → skipped-no-recipient, terminal for that step; later steps re-read the recipient.
verdicts.missing: What happens when an address bounces; bounce processing is declared out of scope, so a bouncing address keeps receiving later steps

verdicts.quote: one message per (invoice, step) to the invoice's single billing-contact address: exactly one To, no Cc/Bcc.
verdicts.missing: Which contact is chosen when the customer or invoice has more than one billing contact

verdicts.quote: per-invoice step history — invoice number, offset, step date, outcome (R-8 set), attempts, handled date, recipient address as used — filterable by invoice number
Body ... contains: customer name, invoice number, remaining balance ..., due date as `20 March 2026`, and how to pay: the invoice's payment link if the source provides one
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link expires and what happens if it has

verdicts.quote: only administrators read/change settings and read history.
verdicts.missing: Who may send or stop a reminder by hand; no manual send/stop is specified

verdicts.quote: an administrator can turn reminders on/off ... Out of scope (bounded by this R): per-invoice or per-customer schedules
verdicts.missing: Per-customer turn-off, preview/dry-run, and manual resend are not specified

verdicts.quote: an administrator can list (a) per-invoice step history — ... outcome (R-8 set) ... and (b) run records (R-4).
verdicts.missing: A view of what the system will send next (upcoming reminders)

verdicts.quote: Unresolved: acceptable maximum run duration / time of last send after 09:00, expected invoice volume per run ... no numeric bound is asserted.
verdicts.missing: A numeric bound on sending volume or on how late after 09:00 a reminder may go out

verdicts.quote: Observed only; the reminder component never writes it ... Before/after a run: no (invoice, offset) has more than one provider hand-over; the invoice source is unchanged
